title: Why having too many choices actually makes you indecisive
hook: Why does picking a film feel so hard?

narration.text: When you have too many options, your brain can struggle to make a decision.
This is called choice overload, and it makes simple tasks much harder.
Your brain uses more energy to weigh each additional option.
This mental effort can lead to decision fatigue and procrastination.
You might feel overwhelmed, or even avoid making any choice at all.
It applies to small things, like choosing a coffee, or big life decisions.
Have you ever felt paralysed by too many options?

description: Discover why having an abundance of choices can actually hinder your decision-making process. Learn about choice overload and its surprising effects on your brain and daily life. It is not just about big decisions, but everyday choices too.
topic: Why you might struggle to make a decision when faced with too many choices, explaining choice overload.
